Commentary.Commentary: So, we have the two finalists. Sri Lanka Women will take on India Women. A comfortable win here for Sri Lanka. Join us for the epic clash on the 25th of this month at 11.30 am IST (6 am GMT). Do join us for the build up. Till then, goodbye and cheers!

India vs Sri Lanka in the Asia Cup Final. India Women vs Sri Lanka Women in the Asian Games Final. What a win for the Lankan. An easy one as the bowlers did the job for them. They were chasing a below par total and Chamari Athapaththu gave a blistering start. Pakistan Women bowled well in phases but were always short of runs. They took wickets but needed more than that. Sri Lanka Women on the other end needed a couple of players to big and it was Nilakshi de Silva in the end who stayed back to hit the winning runs. A fantastic job from Sri Lanka Women and they have set a date with India for the gold medal.
SIX! That will do! This is very full and on middle, Nilakshi de Silva smokes it down to long on for a biggie. Sri Lanka Women win by 6 wickets.
